question: What shared side effects do Acetylsalicylic acid and Warfarin have?
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug {name: 'Acetylsalicylic acid'})-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) WITH se MATCH (d2:Drug {name: 'Warfarin'})-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se) RETURN se.name ORDER BY se.name LIMIT 10

question: Do Metformin and Rosiglitazone share gene targets?
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug {name: 'Metformin'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH g MATCH (d2:Drug {name: 'Rosiglitazone'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g) RETURN g.gene_name

question: What is the polypharmacy risk between Ibuprofen and Naproxen — shared gene targets?
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug {name: 'Ibuprofen'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH g MATCH (d2:Drug {name: 'Naproxen'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g) RETURN g.gene_name ORDER BY g.gene_name

question: Do Metformin and Warfarin share any gene targets?
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug {name: 'Metformin'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH g MATCH (d2:Drug {name: 'Warfarin'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g) RETURN g.gene_name
